name: index-basket
description: Tokenised index fund on Hedera: one HBAR deposit buys a weighted basket on SaucerSwap V2, mints an HTS share token, redeems in kind, and rebalances itself through the Hedera Schedule Service with Chainlink USD pricing.

steps.text: BasketVault buys WHBAR, SAUCE and USDC on SaucerSwap V2, mints an HTS share token, and books its own rebalances with the Hedera Schedule Service. Contracts run against Hedera testnet; there is no local chain step.

steps.label: Install the Foundry build Hashio accepts (Foundry 1.8 is rejected, hiero-json-rpc-relay#5826)
Put its key in packages/foundry/.env as DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY, then deploy and run every flow on testnet

steps.text: README.md walks through the design; AGENTS.md briefs coding agents.
